name: Jeanne Tuft Residence

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single primary residence with a brown shingle roof and multiple roof planes|A paved driveway leads from the street to the front of the house and an attached garage|A wooden deck extends along the rear of the house|A fenced yard area is attached to one side of the structure|Scattered trees surround the lot, with dry open ground and patches of lawn around the building.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence faces the street with a paved driveway leading to a covered entry and garage|The house has a brown shingle roof and windows along the front elevation|Trees stand in the front yard and along the street|Lawn and dry ground surround the driveway approach.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the rear wooden deck on posts and the side elevation of the house|Trees line the street and yard|A paved driveway and street curve along one edge of the lot|Dry ground and scattered vegetation surround the structure.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence shows the wooden deck, the attached garage, and a fenced side yard|The paved driveway approaches from the street|Trees surround the lot|Dry ground and limited lawn are present around the building|The deck sits above grade on support posts.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the long side of the house, the fenced yard, and trees along the lot edge|The paved street and driveway are visible at the front|Dry open ground extends beyond the fence|Roof planes and a chimney are visible from this angle.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway from Duck Pond Ln to the front of the house and garage. The lot is in a residential neighborhood with neighboring homes on adjacent streets. Scattered trees surround the house and may limit visibility from the street and between sides of the property. The rear deck and fenced side yard create enclosed outdoor space. Dry ground around the structure provides some open movement once on site, though tree coverage is close on multiple sides.
clarifications: Does the driveway terminate at the garage, or is there vehicle access around the house? Are there any gates in the side yard fence? Is there a walkway from the deck to the ground that is not clear in the imagery? Are there additional pedestrian access points from the street besides the driveway? How close is tree coverage to the roof and deck for movement around all sides of the house?
